update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.0 - Trainee rotation, preset overhaul, two months of reliability work
- Trainee rotation: queue several different trainees and the bot trains each under her own preset, switching automatically between careers (off by default). - 81 character presets across 27 characters - added Symboli Rudolf and the June banner trainees, with rebuilt stat priorities, sparks, caps, and event picks. - New knapsack skill-buying strategy, and the buy pass now verifies each purchase actually commits. - Junior fan-gate fixed: reads single-star predictions and forces fan-goal races so Medium/Long trainees clear the wall. - Major stability pass: serialized OCR (no more native crashes), accessibility self-heal, settings-DB hardening, watchdog deadlock fix, career-end exit fixes. - x86_64 APK for native-speed emulator runs.
